alternative_sources.reported_item: PPE depreciation claimed as capitalised in inventories
alternative_sources.locator: p120 Note 15 PDF original page: depreciation allocation paragraph

conflicts.resolution: Use the PPE rollforward total of 1,602,828 and the audited expense/segment total of 1,383,971 as controls. The stated 1,534,990 capitalised in inventories cannot coexist arithmetically with those controls and is excluded; the internal transfer amount remains an unresolved disclosure inconsistency.

disclosure_limitations.description: The annual report PDF states RMB1,534,990,000 of PPE depreciation was capitalised in inventories, inconsistent with the PPE rollforward total RMB1,602,828,000 and P&L PPE depreciation RMB1,383,971,000. No precise operating-asset-to-inventory transfer is asserted.
